name: Aliceforte Lidlow
original_name: アリスフォルテ・リッドロウ
source: A human hero who is said to have defeated the ''Black Clothed Witch'', who plotted the destruction of the world five years ago. He's extremely good natured and is not good at refusing requests from others. Also the leader of a local group of thieves, who earn money by slaying monsters.
translation: A human hero who is said to have defeated the ''Black Clothed Witch'', who plotted the destruction of the world five years ago. He's extremely good natured and is not good at refusing requests from others. Also the leader of a local group of thieves, who earn money by slaying monsters.
